notes.title: Thank You for over 20,000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477020/cd12c936733ffea79eed2fdc78705fd4c24097ae.gif"]Now over 20,000 souls have added Forbidden Solitaire to their wishlists.

We extend our gratitude to all of you - despite our growing sense of unease. 

Grisly and inexplicable events seem to surround this game. As ever, we urge you to proceed with the utmost caution...should you decide to recommend it to those in your circle:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414580/Forbidden_Solitaire/"][/dynamiclink]
